text.en:
Subsistence Allowance. The Subsistence Allowance for Officers
and Enlisted Personnel of the AFP, including trainees and Probationary Second
Lieutenants/Ensigns undergoing military training, Citizen Military Training cadets on
summer camp training and reserve officers and enlisted reservists undergoing training
and assembly/mobilization test, Citizen Armed Force Geographical Unit, and cadets,
is hereby increased from One Hundred Fifty Pesos (P150.00) to Three Hundred Fifty
Pesos (P350.00) per day, effective 01 January 2025.

Funding. The amounts necessary to carry out the implementation
of this Order shall be charged against available appropriations of the AFP under
Republic Act No. 12116 or the "General Appropriations Act for Fiscal Year 2025," and
such other funding sources that the DBM may identify, subject to relevant budgeting,
accounting, and auditing laws, rules and regulations. Thereafter, the funding
requirements necessary for the continued implementation of this Order shall be
included in the budget proposals of the AFP, subject to the usual budget preparation

Separability. If any section or part of this Order is declared
unconstitutional or invalid, the other sections or provisions not otherwise affected shall
remain in full force and effect.

Repeal. All orders, rules and regulations, and other issuances or
parts thereof, which are inconsistent with this Order, are hereby repealed or modified
accordingly.

Effectivity. This Order shall take effect immediately upon
publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
DONE, in the City of Manila, this 14th dav of
vear of Our Lord, Two Thousand and Twenty-Five.
By the President:
